title: Antimicrobial Properties and Membrane-Active Mechanism of a Potential alpha-Helical Antimicrobial Derived from Cathelicidin PMAP-36

materials_exhausted.note: Local materials were sufficient to close the worker-4/6 ticket with explicit cautions; exact hemolysis percentages remain database/figure-context values rather than primary numeric-table values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material is complete-with-gaps but sufficient for worker-4/6: primary XML/PDF, OA package figures, Table S1 DOC, and linked database rows were reopened.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural artifact presence is treated only as validator readiness, not publication acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Table 1 reports C-terminal amidation for the synthesized peptides; linked database sequence strings generally omit the -NH2 suffix, so final database statuses preserve this explicitly.
Linked DBAASP rows provide exact hemolysis percentages; local primary material provides Figure 2 and qualitative text, not a machine-readable numeric hemolysis table.
Some database MIC=2 µM E. coli ATCC 25922 rows lack salt-treatment context; primary Table 2 baseline and Table S1 salt MICs are kept separate.
CAMP linked entries use a generic PMAP-36 title for specific Table 1 derivative sequences; sequence/activity evidence is retained while the naming conflict is explicit.

summary: Worker-4/6 source review closed the open ticket with accepted_with_cautions: primary tables, supplementary Table S1, mechanism figures/text, and merged database rows support the final curation while database-only and modification-normalization limitations remain explicit.
